pages.title: State of Global Air (SoGA) 2025 — air pollution deaths in India

facts.text: By: Health Effects Institute (HEI) and IHME (USA)
facts.head: Report

facts.text: India 2023: ~2 million deaths — +43% from 1.4 million (2000); 89% from NCDs
facts.head: Report

facts.text: Death rate: 186 per 100,000 vs 17 in high-income countries (>10×)
facts.head: Report

facts.text: States >1 lakh deaths: Maharashtra, UP, Rajasthan, Bihar, West Bengal
facts.head: Report

facts.text: Air pollution share: 70% COPD, 33% lung cancer, >25% heart disease, ~20% diabetes deaths
facts.head: Report

facts.text: 75% of Indians exposed above WHO interim target 35 µg/m³
facts.head: Report

facts.text: Dementia: 626,000 global deaths; India 54,000
facts.head: Report

facts.text: 8 million deaths/year — 4.9 million outdoor, 2.8 million household, rest ozone
facts.head: Global

facts.text: SDG 3.4: cut premature NCD deaths by one-third by 2030
facts.head: Global

facts.text: Released by: HP CM Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu in Chandigarh; with UNDP
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: HDI: 0.78 vs national 0.63
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: Literacy: 99.3% — fully literate; reading/writing rank 5th (from 21st in 2021)
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: IMR: 21 per 1,000; life expectancy 72; poverty below 7%
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: Schemes: Rajiv Gandhi Self-Employment Start-up Scheme (₹680 crore, 50% subsidy on e-taxis); Rajiv Gandhi Self-Employment Solar Energy Scheme (100 kW–2 MW; interest subsidy 5% tribal / 4% non-tribal)
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: ⚠ HP — first hill state with strong EV policy; public transport electrified by 2030
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: India HDI 0.63; rank 130 of 193; Medium human development; top — Switzerland
facts.head: India in HDR 2025

pages.title: Lancet Countdown 2025 — health and climate change

facts.text: Prepared by: University College London with WHO
facts.head: Air pollution

facts.text: India: 1.72 million deaths/year from anthropogenic PM2.5 — +38% since 2010; global 2.5 million (source: India ~70% of global)
facts.head: Air pollution

facts.text: Fossil fuels: 44% (7.52 lakh) — coal 394,000 (power plants 298,000); petrol & diesel 269,000
facts.head: Air pollution

facts.text: Wildfire smoke: 10,200 deaths/year (2020–2024), +28%
facts.head: Air pollution

facts.text: Household pollution: 113 per 100,000 (2022) — rural 125, urban 99
facts.head: Air pollution

facts.text: Economic cost: $339.4 billion (2022) = 9.5% of GDP
facts.head: Air pollution

facts.text: 50% more heatwave days in 2024; 366 extra hours per person
facts.head: Heat and disease

facts.text: 419 lost labour hours per person (+124% vs 1990s); income loss $194 billion
facts.head: Heat and disease

facts.text: Extreme drought area +138%; dengue (Aedes albopictus) potential doubled; Vibrio +46%
facts.head: Heat and disease

facts.text: NCAP: launched 2019
facts.head: Heat and disease

pages.title: NITI Aayog report — India's services sector and employment

facts.text: Report: "India's Services Sector: Insights from Employment Trends and State-Level Dynamics" (2025); companion report on GVA trends
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: Services: >55% of GVA but < one-third of workforce
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: Services employment share 26.9% (2011–12) → 29.7% (2023–24); ~40 million jobs added; global average 50%
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: Urban >60% workers in services vs rural <20%; rural women only 10.5%
facts.head: Findings

facts.text: Leading states: Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Telangana; lagging: Bihar, MP, UP, Odisha
facts.head: Findings
